title: AuthContext
description: Server-derived authentication and authorization context. Computed exclusively on the institutional backend from verified JWT/session claims. Never trusted from client-supplied payload parameters.

user_id.description: Unique identifier of the authenticated user

role.description: Server-assigned institutional role governing feature and data access level

campus_scope.description: List of campus codes (SCHOOL) the user is authorized to access. Empty array means cross-campus access is denied.

teacher_eid.description: Optional Employee ID (EID) if the user is a teacher, used for automatic row-level scope injection

authenticated_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp of authentication verification

session_expires_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp of token/session expiration
